title: Absolute Batman #1
author: Scott Snyder
synopsis: In the newly launched Absolute Universe, Bruce Wayne is not a billionaire and grows up without the wealth he is known for. When a gang of masked killers terrorizes Gotham City, MI6 agent Alfred Pennyworth is dispatched to investigate, only to discover a brutal new vigilante already hunting them. This Batman is a force of nature with a suit that doubles as a weapon. Through flashbacks, we see Alfred has been secretly observing Bruce, learning about his tragic origin and unwavering mission. This sets the stage for an unlikely partnership between this untested Dark Knight and a spy who has found a new purpose.

title: All-Star Superman Vol. 1
author: Grant Morrison
synopsis: A powerful retelling of Superman's greatest adventures as he faces his mortality and performs heroic feats.

title: Superman: Birthright
author: Mark Waid & Leinil Francis Yu
synopsis: A modern retelling of Superman's origin story. After twelve years traveling the world, Clark Kent returns to Metropolis to begin his career as a reporter. He adopts the identity of Superman to protect the city from threats like the terrorist organization known as the Brotherhood of Steel. As Superman faces his first major battles, he must also confront the secrets of his Kryptonian heritage and decide what kind of hero he wants to be.

title: One Piece, Vol 1: Romance Dawn
author: Eiichiro Oda
synopsis: Monkey D. Luffy is a young boy with an unshakable dream to become the Pirate King and find the legendary treasure known as the One Piece. Inspired by the pirate captain Red-Haired Shanks, who saved his life and gave him his treasured straw hat, Luffy sets out to sea to assemble a crew and begin his adventure. Luffy possesses the power of the Gum-Gum Fruit, a cursed Devil Fruit that gave him the ability to stretch his body like rubber but took away his ability to swim. In this first volume, Luffy meets and recruits the fearsome bounty hunter Roronoa Zoro and has his first encounters with colorful villains as he begins his grand adventure on the high seas.

title: Amazing Fantasy Vol. 1 #15
author: Stan Lee & Steve Ditko
synopsis: Peter Parker is but a lonely high-school student until one day whilst he attends a science experiment during which a spider absorbs an uncanny amount of radiation before biting him. Soon after Peter discovers that he has gained powers similar to that of a spider. He is incredibly strong, can stick to walls and now has increased senses. Deciding to use his newfound powers to earn some money he creates the identity of Spider-Man for himself and soon becomes an overnight sensation. With his new found fame and success Peter becomes much more selfish and fails to stop a fleeing criminal claiming from now on he only looks out for himself and his Aunt and Uncle.

title: Amazing Spider-Man #1
author: Stan Lee & Steve Ditko
synopsis: Following his origin in Amazing Fantasy #15, Peter Parker balances his life as a high school student with his crimefighting duties as Spider-Man. In this first issue, Spider-Man faces off against the Chameleon, a master of disguise who frames him for a crime he didn't commit. Meanwhile, Peter must deal with the pressure from J. Jonah Jameson's crusade against him and his promise to his dying Uncle Ben that with great power comes great responsibility.

title: Batman - Year One (TPB)
author: Frank Miller & David Mazzuchelli
synopsis: One of the most important and critically acclaimed Batman adventures ever. Written by Frank Miller with art by David Mazzuchelli. This collection tells the entire dramatic story of Batman's first year fighting crime and includes new introductions, reproductions of original pencils, promotional art, unseen Mazzuchelli Batman art, color samples, script pages and other surprises.

title: Uncanny X-Men #1
author: Stan Lee & Jack Kirby
synopsis: Professor Charles Xavier recruits five extraordinary teenagers to fight evil. These young mutants possess incredible powers and must learn to control their abilities while protecting a world that fears and hates them. Their first mission pits them against the powerful Magneto, who has declared war on humanity.

title: One Piece, Vol 2: Buggy the Clown
author: Eiichiro Oda
synopsis: Luffy and his new crew continue their journey and encounter the fearsome pirate clown Buggy, a Devil Fruit user who can split his body into pieces. Meanwhile, the beautiful but treacherous Nami joins the crew, and Luffy searches for a swordsman to complete his growing pirate band.

title: Wonder Woman By George Perez Vol. 1
author: George Perez
synopsis: George Perez's legendary run on Wonder Woman begins with this collection that redefines the Amazon Princess for a new era. Diana leaves her home of Themyscira to travel to Man's World, where she must learn to navigate the complexities of modern society while battling gods, monsters, and the machinations of Ares, the God of War. This volume showcases Perez's stunning artwork and epic storytelling as he builds the mythology of Wonder Woman from the ground up.

title: Giant Size X-Men #1 Facsimile Edition
author: Len Wein & Dave Cockrum
synopsis: The iconic 1975 comic that redefined the X-Men is reproduced in this facsimile edition. Professor Charles Xavier recruits a new team of mutants from around the world to rescue the original X-Men from the living island of Krakoa. This issue introduced fan-favorite characters including Wolverine, Storm, Nightcrawler, Colossus, and Thunderbird, launching the X-Men franchise into a new era of international superhero adventures.
